headline: Ye casually previewed “All of the Lights” during a livestream before anyone knew it would
body: Ye casually previewed “All of the Lights” during a livestream before anyone knew it would become one of the biggest songs of his career 😭🔥 Nearly 16 years later, the My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy classic has officially surpassed 1 BILLION streams on Spotify, becoming Ye’s 16th song to reach the milestone. The track also peaked at No. 18 on the Billboard Hot 100, earned a 7× Platinum certification in the US and won two Grammy Awards 🏆 One of the greatest rap songs of the 2010s still sounds larger than life today 🤯

source_caption_text:
Ye casually previewed “All of the Lights” during a livestream before anyone knew it would become one of the biggest songs of his career 😭🔥

Nearly 16 years later, the My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy classic has officially surpassed 1 BILLION streams on Spotify, becoming Ye’s 16th song to reach the milestone. The track also peaked at No. 18 on the Billboard Hot 100, earned a 7× Platinum certification in the US and won two Grammy Awards 🏆

One of the greatest rap songs of the 2010s still sounds larger than life today 🤯
